children: Cybertruck Sales Remain Far Below Musk’s Earlier Ambitions
Musk once set an aggressive target for Tesla’s Cybertruck, the electric pickup launched in 2023. Three years later, the vehicle’s performance remains well short of those expectations.

New data examined how many Cybertrucks Tesla sold during the third quarter and compared the results with Musk’s original goal of reaching 250,000 annual sales. The figures indicate that demand has not approached that benchmark.
